releases.name: Brave Dungeon - The Meaning of Justice -
releases.summary: A sequel that inherits the basic system of the previous Brave Dungeon. You can play in different stories and different systems with the scenarios of the three protagonists.

releases.name: John Fox
releases.summary:
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. 

You have to avenge him!

releases.name: Ironforged
releases.summary: Slow-paced, tactical VR shooter where every mistake is punished. You fight with a minimal arsenal - your pistol, composure, timing, and precision. Wake up as CM-42 and fight your way out of a relentless combat training facility designed to break the weak and forge perfect soldiers.

releases.name: Task Force Ranger - Breakpoint
releases.summary:
Task Force Ranger: Breakpoint is a modern military shooter focused on intense combat and high-risk special operations.

Deploy as Bravo Team in the conflict zone of Al-Shamal and carry out a series of dangerous missions against the Jazeera Front. Recover critical intelligence, destroy enemy infrastructure, eliminate hostile leadership, and cripple their ability to operate across the region.

Fight through fortified compounds, industrial facilities, urban districts, and remote mountain strongholds. Expect heavy resistance, armored threats, and large-scale firefights as enemy forces attempt to stop your advance.

Use assault rifles, machine guns, sniper rifles, pistols, explosives, and support weapons to complete your objectives and survive overwhelming odds.

Beyond the campaign, test your skills in Survival Mode, where endless enemy waves push your combat abilities to the limit. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and see how long you can hold the line.

releases.name: I am Titan
releases.summary: I am Titan

releases.name: Tailbreak
releases.summary: Dinosaurs return in this on-rails action shooter with a feral twist!

releases.name: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
releases.summary: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party is a family-focused party game for one to four players who can choose from 40 different lemming characters to play. The Lemmings compete across 50 zany mini-games, six game modes and five boards, inspired by the series, in a mad race to grab as much Yummy as possible right under Grizzy's nose - and he's not about to let them get away with it!

releases.name: REANIMAL: The Prisoner
releases.summary:
Tarsier Studios are back with a new chapter in the dread-filled co-op horror adventure game REANIMAL. This DLC features two brand new characters, The Soldier and the Prisoner, who must survive the war-ravaged streets of a once-familiar place, stumbling blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever. Explore previously unseen areas of the world of REANIMAL, on foot and otherwise, and discover that while war can be hell, some experiences are even worse.

The Prisoner is the first of three REANIMAL DLCs. Each continues the story of the new characters the Soldier and the Prisoner.

releases.name: Parkasaurus: Dinoluxe Edition
releases.summary:
Build your own dinosaur theme park full of cute dinos and prehistoric hijinks.

Experience the prehistoric hijinks of building your very own dinosaur theme park in Parkasaurus. Packed with adorable, mischievous dinos to discover, this tycoon management sim challenges you to design exhibits and conduct research that allow your herd to thrive and your profits to grow. Customize your park, hire employees, and create amazing exhibits your guests will love. But beware! These dinos love to escape and go on a rampage.

Includes the Sea Monsters and Prehistoric Wonders DLCs. Prehistoric Wonders adds 10 new creatures to discover, including Mammoth, Dire Wolf, and Giant Capybara. Sea Monsters allows you to unlock 10 new sea creatures that live in 3 new biomes. Raise a Mosasaurus from a baby or create the perfect home for your ancient Archelon using fluid water physics to construct aquatic habitats.

Building the ideal dinosaur exhibit is no small feat. Each dino requires a unique biosphere, which means the shape of exhibit, materials used, ecology, plants, elevation, and humidity all play a key role in the success of your dinos. Acquire dino eggs, hatch them in their exhibit, then nurture dinos until they are fully grown. Watch out for dinos that break out, which can lead to chaos, destruction, and plenty of laughs as you switch to first-person mode to diffuse the situation.

releases.name: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE
releases.summary:
In the year 2413, the Earth was invaded by evil space pirates “Van-De-Raus”. They are dominating 5 big economic cities and taking control of the world economy.

Friendly planet, Petelgeuse, decided to save the Earth from space pirates and send reinforcement. Ace pirots, Mary and Kanon, ride on ESTIQUE and now launching to the Earth. Mary, you must be the messiah of the Earth. A tomorrow winner is you!

releases.name: Feudal Baron: King's Land
releases.summary:
Turn a humble settlement into a medieval city! In Feudal Baron: King’s Land, you build houses, craftsmanship workshops or churches, fight battles, and create supply chains mightier than swords to satisfy your fussy citizens – or to squeeze them to the last penny.

In Feudal Baron: King’s Land, you play as the ruler of a medieval barony. You start with just a few followers in their leaky tents. Are you a leader shrewd enough to turn your lands into a bustling city?

In this strategic city builder, you’ll get to live in the middle ages, constructing buildings, producing and delivering resources, and fighting off raiders until you’re strong enough to challenge the king himself.

releases.name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4
releases.summary: The latest entry in the Legend of Dark Witch series—over 500,000 copies sold since 2014! A retro-style 2D action game where adorable girls come to life in charming pixel art!

releases.name: Mai: Child of Ages - Storms of Time
releases.summary:
The sudden appearance of a floating factory marks the beginning of a new chapter in the story of Mai: Child of Ages.

Explore brand-new dungeons set inside this colossal airborne structure, filled with ancient machinery, moving platforms, and forgotten experiments.


As Mai ventures deeper into its depths, she will uncover secrets tied to the factory’s origin and the mysterious machines that built it.


Face new enemies, overcome environmental hazards, and solve brand-new puzzles as you explore interconnected areas designed to challenge both your combat and platforming skills.


Main Features

· A new story chapter
· New dungeons set inside a massive floating factory and long-forgotten caverns
· Unique level design with vertical exploration
· New enemies, traps, and puzzles
· Lore that expands the game world
· New craftable items

The skies are no longer safe. What lies within the floating factory could change the course of time.

releases.name: Yellowcreek Stories - The Cabin Watcher
releases.summary: A masked killer hunts you in the dark. Manage noise and light, hide quickly, and survive this intense first-person stealth horror experience inspired by classic 80s slasher films.

releases.name: Combat School
releases.summary:
Before you save your country, you have to survive your sergeant.
Atten-hut! Welcome to the marines. My name's Sgt. J.T. Tail Kicker, and while you're here I'm gonna whip your scrawny hide into shape.
You hear me, boy? Wipe that silly smile off your face, this ain't no circus!
Before you leave, your lungs will burn on the obstacle course. Your fingers will cramp on the firing range. Your muscles will ache during chin ups and arm wrestling. Your stamina will suffer in the iron man race.
And if there's anything left of you, I'll give you a shot at me.
Can you take it, boy? You better. Cause terrorists have attacked our embassy, and America's depending on a real marine to save the day.
So suck in that gut. And have a pleasant stay at Boot Camp.
Featuring simultaneous play for two players or play against the computer.

releases.name: Gummy Invaders
releases.summary:
To denounce the evils of truth and love, the lovely charming germ agents, Gummy Invaders, blasting through the veins at the speed of light! 

In this incremental game, you’ll lead your germ agents through constant evolution. 

Upgrade skill tree, multiply forces, and teach those troublemakers a lesson!

releases.name: Project Neon
releases.summary:
In the desolate future of 2042, Earth teeters on the brink of ecological collapse due to relentless climate change. The only hope lies with a visionary who abandoned Earth to start anew on Mars, disgusted by humanity‘s negativity and the financial betrayal of his ventures.

"Project Neon" is your top-secret mission to navigate the treacherous cosmos and bring this recluse back from his Martian stronghold, without harming him, to salvage our dying planet. He has fortified Mars with an impenetrable shield, anchored by defenses on four neighboring planets.

Each planet is guarded by fierce enemies and daunting bosses, integral to maintaining the shield. Your task: dismantle this interplanetary defense, planet by planet, in a high-stakes shoot ‘em up adventure.

releases.name: Is This Seat Taken?
releases.summary:
Window seat or aisle? Booth or table? Lone wolf or life of the party? In Is This Seat Taken?, your mission is to organize groups of people according to their preferences. It’s a cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game where you’re in charge of who sits where.

Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. A sleepy passenger won’t be happy trying to nap on the bus next to someone listening to loud music. 

It’s all about reading the room to find the perfect placement!

releases.name: Super Bunny Man
releases.summary: A physics-based couch-coop platformer about a guy in a rabbit costume! Beat levels, time attacks, find hidden carrots, all while evading spikes, boulders, pitfalls, and other challenges! Play campaign mode in singleplayer or co-op with a friend, or play deathmatch with up to 4 players!

releases.name: UFO: A Day in the Life
releases.summary: Console Archives: UFO -A day in the life

releases.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
releases.summary: PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works (Arc), and Marvel Games have joined forces to realize the latest in tag team fighters, MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Experience the Marvel Universe like never before with reimagined characters and stages, a heart-pounding soundtrack, intuitive gameplay mechanics, and jaw-dropping visuals that promise to keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether this is your first fighting game or you are a veteran of the genre, Arc has incorporated gameplay controls and mechanics that are easy to pick up and play, and yet still offer the depth and versatility for high level competition. Enter the fray with iconic Marvel heroes and villains such as Captain America, Iron Man, Spider-Man, Doctor Doom, Storm, Ms. Marvel, Star-Lord, and Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes) – each with Arc’s unique twist on their character designs and gameplay styles. [PlayStation]

releases.name: Route-16 Turbo
releases.summary:
Route16 Turbo is an action game released in 1985.

Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

releases.name: Mate'Morphosis
releases.summary:
Mate'Morphosis is a pixel art, chess-inspired puzzle game built around the concept of becoming the piece you capture.

Outsmart each board, adapt to evolving mechanics, and hunt down the rival king across every stage.

releases.name: Super Robot Wars Y: Anniversary Expansion Pack
releases.summary:
20 Million Copies Sold Commemorative Mission
    35th Anniversary Commemorative Mission
    New game mode “BOOST” added
    Pilot level cap raised
    Further improvements to stability

“Anniversary Expansion Pack: The Accelerating Future”

    33 new Area Missions
    12 new weapons
    Five new playable units
    One new Assist Crew member
    Bonus Mission “Anniversary Expansion Purchase Bonus”
